question: Should compaction events be auto-detected vs requiring manual store_compaction_summary calls?
context: compaction_memory_tools.py had a TODO since v1.x. Manual flow works (instances call store_compaction_summary at the right moment); auto-detection would need a heuristic on the dispatcher side (e.g., context-window pressure signals). Likely premature optimization until we have data on whether instances actually forget to call the manual tool.
